extraction.distinctness_review: All four baseline identity layers were searched: 1,296 sites, 1,405 projects, 231 source records, and 231 identity-mapping records plus 231 decisions. Searches covered OVH/OVHcloud, Beauharnois, Aluminerie, BHS1–9, Vint Hill, VIN1, 6872 Watson Court and county parcel 7915-86-3249-000. Only the three existing French OVHcloud campuses matched actual operator identities; unrelated OVH substrings inside serialized evidence IDs are not candidate identities. No candidate address, local alias or parcel matched. All 1,296 complete baseline geometries, including polygons and multipolygons, were checked. The nearest existing host is Equinix MT2 in Vaudreuil-Dorion, 16.587 km away. No baseline host is within 3 km. One Beauharnois physical campus is proposed with its BHS6 operations scoped separately; other numbered BHS halls, server manufacturing and any expansion are not additional admitted hosts or commissioned capacity.
